definitions.explanation: To provide mutual support, with each party helping to sustain the other emotionally, physically, or financially.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{支|ささ}え{合|あ}って⟦{生|い}きて→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧⟦いく→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: A married couple lives by supporting each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧⟦{時|とき}→とき：02918_toki⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧{支|ささ}え{合|あ}う⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's especially important to support each other during difficult times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{支|ささ}え{合|あ}う⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: We aim for a society where the community supports each other.

notes:
{支|ささ}え{合|あ}う is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to support each other.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧ (to support) + ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (each other) → to support each other

ASPECT (ている):
{支|ささ}え{合|あ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing state of mutual support.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{互|たが}いに→互いに：07150_tagaini⟧{支|ささ}え{合|あ}う (support each other mutually)
- ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧{支|ささ}え{合|あ}う (support each other through difficulties)
- {支|ささ}え{合|あ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (mutually supportive relationship)

RELATED NOUN:
- {支|ささ}え{合|あ}い: mutual support

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}う→助け合う：04654_tasukeau⟧: to help each other (more active assistance)
- {支|ささ}え{合|あ}う emphasizes ongoing support rather than immediate help
